title: Design: the Part Sale parts table with Priced By
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit' and 'Part Sales — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new category for this test, category A, priced by a new matrix for this test, matrix A, with one cost range ($0.00 and up) whose Default rule is Markup % 35.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses, whose column in matrix A is % Off 10.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, put on tier A for Part Sales in Edit Customer.
  • Have a new Part Sale for this test, Part Sale 1, for customer A, made after customer A's tiers were set, with a part in category A priced by tier A.
  • Use a desktop browser window exactly 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so the screen matches the design pictures' size.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The parts table reads Description, Part Number, Quantity, Cost, Core, Sell Price, Priced By, Margin, Category, Vendor and Requested At, as in picture 13.3.
  • Priced By sits right after Sell Price and shows tier A's name in plain text.
  • Boxes, spacing and alignment match picture 13.3 compared with the design picture at 100% zoom.
  • The heading reads "Priced By" with a capital B.
